lines.text: The LORD tells Moses to chisel out two new stone tablets, and Moses carries them up Mount Sinai alone.
The LORD descends in a pillar of fire and proclaims His name, and Moses bows down and worships.
The LORD promises to drive out the Amorites and other peoples, and He forbids treaties with them and molten gods.
Moses stays with the LORD seven days and seven nights without bread or water, and writes the Ten Commandments.
Moses comes down with a radiant face, and he puts a veil over it after speaking to the Israelites.
